style: Flat-color ink illustration in the manner of Moebius and Kim Jung Gi with a touch of Karl Kopinski: clean confident black ink outlines of even weight, flat cel colors in two or three tones, no gradients and no painterly blur, faint risograph print grain, warm cream paper background, one warm orange light from the upper left, flat deep violet shadow shapes, small hand-drawn imperfections in the line. Limited palette: ink black, cream, sodium amber, sun orange, rose red, teal, violet. Retro-futurist fantasy world under a huge orange sun. Centered object, square composition, generous empty space around it, no text, no letters, no frame, no border.
